pluginId.description: The plugin to associate with this auth link

authorizationVariantId.description: The plugin authorization variant a new link uses. Required when the plugin declares more than one variant. A renewal (an existing authLinkId) must omit it or repeat the stored value; a different value is a 400, because changing variant requires connecting a new link.

regionalizationId.description: The plugin regionalization a new link targets. Required when the chosen variant declares more than one regionalization. A renewal (an existing authLinkId) must omit it or repeat the stored value; a different value is a 400, because changing region requires connecting a new link.

applePushNotificationDeviceToken.description: Device token for Apple Push Notification Service

scopes.description: Granted provider scopes, preserved with the OAuth credentials.

customMetadata.description: Opaque provider-owned credential metadata, such as the Tuya endpoint and account identifiers.

apiKey.description: API key for service authentication (e.g. OpenRouter)

endpointUrl.description: Optional custom endpoint URL stored with an API-key connection for an OpenAI-compatible provider.
